name: Aurum PropTech Ltd
title: Aurum PropTech Ltd - 539289 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Asset-light PropTech with no capacity cycle: Q4 continuing revenue INR 123.85 cr (+10.2% QoQ) and distribution INR 66.87 cr, but continuing PBT only INR 1.85 cr and FY26 loss before tax INR 14.96 cr.

triggers.label: Distribution Q4 revenue INR 66.87 cr
triggers.quote: Distribution segment INR 66.87 crores compared to INR 59.60 crores in the previous quarter, increase of 12.2%.

triggers.label: Continuing PBT fell QoQ
triggers.quote: The profit before tax from continuing operation, INR 1.85 crores compared to profit of INR 2.93 crores in the previous quarter.

triggers.label: Growth ~40% but no formal guidance
triggers.quote: we've consistently delivered a growth of 40% year-on-year from a revenue standpoint

guidance.value: similar trajectory to ~40% YoY over next three years (qualitative, not formal)
guidance.quote: we do see following the similar trajectory as we go in the next into the next three years

guidance.value: profitability trends emergent in rental segment in FY27
guidance.quote: we'll be seeing profitability trends emergent in the rental segment in the current financial year FY '27
we'll definitely come out with a SM REIT in this financial year

guidance.value: retire all lease rental discounting debt by June 30, 2026
guidance.quote: will ensure that we retire all lease rental discounting debt in full by June 30, 2026

red_flags.label: Continuing PBT thin and down QoQ
red_flags.quote: The profit before tax from continuing operation, INR 1.85 crores compared to profit of INR 2.93 crores in the previous quarter.

red_flags.label: Cross-sell still single digit per management
red_flags.quote: Those numbers are still in single digit, and that is one focus that we have this year

red_flags.label: Rental segment loss-making
red_flags.quote: The rental segment from continuing operation and capital segment reported a loss of INR 3.61 crores and INR 0.53 crores respectively

red_flags.label: NestAway houses declining YoY
red_flags.quote: we see a dip in terms of number of houses

evasions.quote: we are not allowed to give forward -looking statements
the distribution segment got augmented by PropTiger and that also answers part of your question one, which is organic growth
So, it's a not a very straightforward answer.
